scale_note: 0=Calm, 100=Captured/Non-functional. Bands: Calm 0-39, Strained 40-59, Warning 60-74, Critical 75-100. Scores are hand-set per review; wire citations belong in the note field.

institutions.name: Federal Courts
institutions.why: Delta +1 from 82. The Court kept taking the administration's emergency applications and kept refusing to explain itself in the same order: the California ballot-segregation request was denied unsigned (11-02), the Big Bend wall relief was granted while the merits were undecided (11-09), and by 11-16 roughly 20,000 California ballots sat with a court-appointed examiner rather than with the county that counted them. That last move is the one that matters for this score: election administration is being resolved by appointing an officer of the court, which is the judiciary absorbing a function the political layer would not perform. The docket is holding; the load on it grew.

institutions.name: Congress
institutions.why: Delta +4 from 76. The chamber is now governing by referral. Massie's privileged impeachment resolution was disposed of 211-204 by a motion to refer it to committee (11-10), with the only no vote the member who filed it - every other member avoided recording a position on eight articles. Two days later White House counsel Scharf wrote to Congress that investigating the executive may itself be criminal conduct (11-11), which is oversight reclassified as an offence rather than defended against. In the same week the FAA's request rose to $50bn with no lifecycle cost estimate in front of a committee that has not scheduled a hearing on the outage. The institution acts when procedurally compelled and not otherwise, and the compulsion is being routed to committee.

institutions.name: Election Offices
institutions.why: Re-stated at 82. The count finished: Alaska's ranked-choice transfer produced a winner and the rule was ratified by the same electorate that produced the Democratic win (11-16), and Mississippi certified affidavit ballots with a Senate race pending without a recount following (11-06). California's 20,000 contested ballots moved to a court-appointed examiner - the machinery did not fail, it handed the question upward. What remains is pressure at the legitimacy layer with no operative instrument, and that is where it sat at the last review. No movement.

institutions.name: Health Agencies
institutions.why: Re-stated at 80. No health-agency capture event logged in the window. USDA's proposed rule narrowing broad-based categorical eligibility (11-10), 6.3 million people, is a welfare-administration action and a proposed rule, not an effect, so it is not scored here. Chronic, not acute; no evidence either way is not a movement.

institutions.name: Civil Service
institutions.why: Re-stated at 91. No new Senate-confirmed departure logged in this window, and the fourth exit (civil division, 11-09) is the last one on the record. Re-stating rather than nudging: the offices emptied last week are still empty, the litigation load is still arriving, and the absence of a fresh resignation is not evidence the drain stopped - it is the absence of reporting. A clean week in a series that ran three weeks does not move a score.

institutions.name: Military Leadership
institutions.why: Delta +4 from 74. The force is being moved into the cabinet's physical defence. Bessent relocated to a military base after Iranian threats, with Hegseth and Rubio on Generals' Row at Fort McNair, Hegseth in Quarters 8, and Noem, Miller and Bondi also reported in base housing (11-11) - senior civilians living inside the uniformed perimeter at $4,655 a month. At the same time the secretary's first Pentagon press conference in six months opened with a security agent warning reporters they would be physically removed for lack of decorum (11-10). No uniformed public non-concurrence has appeared. The change is that the institution is now providing domestic protection for the officials who command it, which converts any later refusal into a break rather than a filing.

institutions.name: Dollar & Credit
institutions.why: Delta +4 from 69. The repricing moved from sentiment to capital structure. Nvidia's board refused its former chief executive's return while the company's top lawyer was reported misled about an affair (11-13), and Anthropic priced a $64.4bn offering at up to $1.4tn against a $104bn nine-month loss, with a $26bn private placement of non-voting shares taken by its own compute suppliers at the offer price (11-16). Suppliers underwriting their customer's float is a credit fact, not a market mood. Oil refused the escalation: Brent settled below $95 on the day the IRGC claimed six tanker sinkings. Warning band, moving toward the top.
